'''Probe killers''' were tiny six legged [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] that could be carried inside the small pits on the head of the larger [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]], where they lay dormant until the assassin probe activated them. They were similar in appearance to their larger companions, but only a small fraction of their size.<ref name="vot" /> Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swa-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> assassin probes and probe killers were used on the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] in an attempt to assassinate [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. Most of the droids were destroyed in the initial attempt, but [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] found a survivor, which he used to identify the traitor aboard the ship.<ref name="vot" />
